step1.title: Choose your language
step1.subtitle: This language will be used throughout the wizard and the dashboard.

step2.title: Odoo connection
step2.subtitle: Manufactoo needs to connect to your existing Odoo instance as its master data source (products, bills of materials, manufacturing orders). Enter the connection details and run the test to continue: the Odoo version (18 or 19) is detected automatically.
step2.hostHint: If Odoo is installed on your own machine (not in a Docker container), use 'host.docker.internal' instead of 'localhost'.

step3.title: Company details
step3.subtitle: This information will be used to set up your installation.
step3.name: Company name

step4.title: Administrator user
step4.subtitle: This will be the user you sign in to Manufactoo with.
step4.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters

step5.title: Summary
step5.subtitle: Review the details before finishing the installation.
